answer: A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 13 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a cipher bet on surviving 92 epochs of grading, and every ripple settlement recomputes the opal schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 92 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 9 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
